newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March chain store sales up 8.4 pct year/year.
newsitem.headline: Japan March chain store sales up 8.4 pct year/year.

text.p: Sales at chain stores in Japan in March rose 8.4 percent from a year earlier to 1.52 trillion yen, the Japan Chain Stores' Association said on Thursday.
Month on month, chain stores posted a 26.4 percent increase in March, the association said in a statement.
The association said sales at chain stores in Japan in the year ending March 31, 1997 rose 0.7 percent from the previous year to 16.98 trillion yen.

The association said there was a rush of purchases of home electrical appliances, household items and interior decorating items in March, especially during the last week of the month, ahead of the rise in the sales tax to five percent on April 1.
Sales of such items as wide-screen televisions, refrigerators and furniture in March rose 46.4 percent from the previous month.
It said sales of men's and women's clothing, as well as foodstuffs such as rice and seasonings, also rose in March due to the imminent rise in the consumption tax.
The report was based on a survey of 7,822 outles of 131 chain store operators in Japan.
